```{r Plot Setup}
# Colors
new_colors_face <- c("#FF0000","#8B0000")
new_colors_body <- c("#E4CD04","#BA8E23")
new_colors_place <- c("#008000","#013220")


# Fill

```

```{r}
perform_and_save_t_tests <- function(data, split_var, group_var, measure_var, output_file_base) {
  # 1) Filter & split by hemisphere × ROI
  data_filtered <- data %>%
    filter(hemi %in% c("lh","rh"),
           !(ROI %in% c("blank","blank1","blank2","blank3","blank4"))) %>%
    na.omit()

  split_data <- split(data_filtered, list(data_filtered$hemi, data_filtered$ROI))

  # 2) Per-split Welch t-test (adolescents vs Adults)
  perform_t_test <- function(df) {
    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
    group_data <- df %>% filter(!!sym(group_var) == "adolescents") %>% pull(!!sym(measure_var))
    adult_data <- df %>% filter(!!sym(group_var) == "Adults")       %>% pull(!!sym(measure_var))
    if (length(group_data) > 0 & length(adult_data) > 0) {
      tt <- t.test(group_data, adult_data, var.equal = FALSE)
      tibble(
        hemi             = unique(df$hemi),
        ROI              = unique(df$ROI),
        t_statistic      = unname(tt$statistic),
        p_value          = unname(tt$p.value),
        df               = unname(tt$parameter),
        mean_adolescents = mean(group_data, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_Adults      = mean(adult_data,  na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    } else NULL
  }

  res <- map_dfr(split_data, perform_t_test)

  # 3) Save (full + significant after BH-FDR)
  if (!missing(output_file_base) && !is.null(output_file_base)) {
    write_csv(res, paste0(output_file_base, "_all.csv"))
    res_sig <- res %>% mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>% filter(p_adj < 0.05)
    write_csv(res_sig, paste0(output_file_base, "_sig.csv"))
  }
  res
}

p_to_stars <- function(p) dplyr::case_when(
  is.na(p)   ~ "",
  p < 0.001  ~ "***",
  p < 0.01   ~ "**",
  p < 0.05   ~ "*",
  TRUE       ~ ""
)
# Build a star table from your t-test output (hemi×ROI)
build_star_tbl <- function(tt_res, y_top){
  tt_res %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      stars = p_to_stars(p_value),      # <-- unadjusted p
      lab   = stars,                    # stars only (no arrows)
      x     = paste0("Adults.", hemi),  # exact discrete x used in plots
      y     = y_top
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(lab != "")
}

tt_centerY <- perform_and_save_t_tests(
  data = df.centers_cat, split_var = c("hemi","ROI"),
  group_var = "group", measure_var = "centerY",
  output_file_base = file.path(output_directory, "t_centerY")  # or NULL to skip saving
)
stars_centerY <- build_star_tbl(tt_centerY, y_top = 8.2)

tt_centerR <- perform_and_save_t_tests(
  data = df.centers_cat, split_var = c("hemi","ROI"),
  group_var = "group", measure_var = "centerR",
  output_file_base = file.path(output_directory, "t_centerR")
)
stars_centerR <- build_star_tbl(tt_centerR, y_top = 16.8)

tt_size <- perform_and_save_t_tests(
  data = df.centers_cat, split_var = c("hemi","ROI"),
  group_var = "group", measure_var = "size",
  output_file_base = file.path(output_directory, "t_size")
)
stars_size <- build_star_tbl(tt_size, y_top = 24.2)

```

# Y-POSITION
```{r Y-faces, fig.width=12, fig.height=4, warning=F, message=F, echo=FALSE}
png(file.path(output_directory, "F3A_pRFcenters_yPosition_bar_face.png"), units="in", width=4, height=3, res=300)

Y_face <- df.centers_cat %>%
  filter(category == 'face') %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = interaction(group, hemi, sep = "."), 
                y = centerY, 
                fill = group, 
                alpha = stream)) +
    geom_bar(aes(alpha = stream),
           stat = "summary", fun = "mean",
           width = 0.8, position = dodge, size = 1.25) +
  geom_point(size = 1, na.rm = TRUE, color = "#8B0000") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  labs(y = "Y Position  (°)") +
  facet_grid(~ ROI) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y=element_text(size=16),
        panel.spacing = unit(0, "null"),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray96",size = 0.5),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15),
        text = element_text(family = "Avenir"),
        axis.line.x = element_line(color = "white")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = new_colors_face, na.translate = FALSE) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("lateral" = 0.5, "ventral" = .85)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = new_colors_face, na.translate = FALSE) +
  theme(axis.line=element_blank(),axis.text.x=element_blank(),
          axis.text.y=element_blank(),axis.ticks=element_blank(),
          axis.title.x=element_blank(),
          axis.title.y=element_blank(),legend.position="none") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-8, 8, 4), limits = c(-9, 9)) 

Y_face
```

```{r}
  inherit.aes = FALSE, family = "Avenir", fontface = "bold", size = 6
)

size_body <- size_body + geom_text(
  data = stars_size %>% dplyr::mutate(
           ROI  = factor(ROI, levels = roi_order_byBodies),
           hemi = factor(hemi, levels = c("lh","rh"))),
  aes(x = x, y = y, label = lab),
  inherit.aes = FALSE, family = "Avenir", fontface = "bold", size = 6
)

size_place <- size_place + geom_text(
  data = stars_size %>% dplyr::mutate(
           ROI  = factor(ROI, levels = roi_order_byPlace),
           hemi = factor(hemi, levels = c("lh","rh"))),
  aes(x = x, y = y, label = lab),
  inherit.aes = FALSE, family = "Avenir", fontface = "bold", size = 6
)

size_body + size_face + size_place
```
